description: This file defines the PersistableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It manages category descriptions and parent references, serving as a data model for categories within the application.

classes.name: PersistableCategory
classes.description: A serializable class that extends CategoryEntity, managing category descriptions and parent category references.
